kitDesign: the shared Shiny interface for KIT research tools

Source: R/kitDesign-package.R
kitDesign-package.Rd

The interface layer shared by kitJoin, kitsUI, and future KIT Shiny apps: the theme (kit_theme()), styles and scripts (use_kit()), the page (kit_page()), and components built to the "KIT design language" (kit_*()). The design language lives in the brand/ folder of the package source.

Details

A new app starts like this:

library(kitDesign)
ui <- kit_page("KIT ×× 工具", "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫", version = "0.1.0", date = "2026-10-31",
  kit_tab_guide("這一頁做什麼。", kit_steps("第一步", "第二步"), "會得到什麼。")
)

(The strings are the app's on-screen Chinese text: "KIT ×× tool", "the KIT database", "What this page does.", "Step one", "Step two", "What you get.")

See every component: kit_gallery().
